description: The ONLY projects `npm run db:push` may target (DEC-2026-023 S1, amendment A-1). Non-production projects only; the production project is never listed. Adding one is a reviewed commit (CODEOWNERS: Data Owner + Security Owner; DEC-2026-018: 24-hour cool-off + checklist). Each entry: { "ref": "<20-char project ref>", "label": "...", "approved_by": "...", "approved_on": "YYYY-MM-DD", "decision": "DEC-..." }. Empty: db:push refuses every project.
